sourceNotes.rawContent: Embrace timeless tradition with this stunning gold-toned nath, intricately studded with ruby and emerald-colored stones. A perfect high-fashion accessory for festive occasions. To ensure its vibrant finish stays beautiful, avoid contact with water or perfumes and store in a dry, airtight container after use.
